primaryGoal: Track weekly cumulative KPI performance (M1 ACV, M1 Count, S0 ACV) within the current quarter to understand week-over-week changes and trending towards targets.
assumptions: The current date falls within an active quarter, and 'this quarter' filter will return valid data.
The 'weekly' aggregation will provide consistent week boundaries for comparison.
Data for 'last week' and 'this week' (current week-to-date) are both available and complete enough for meaningful comparison.
The cumulative_sum formula correctly restarts at the beginning of each quarter as defined by quarter_number().
Mandatory filters (Opportunity Type IN ['existing customer expansion', 'new customer'] AND Opportunity Deployment != 'mode') apply uniformly to all records and KPIs.
The date columns (Opportunity M1 Date, Opportunity S0 Date) are populated and accurate for all relevant opportunities.

phases.phaseDescription: Calculate and analyze the cumulative M1 ACV from the start of the current quarter on a weekly basis to determine the change from last week to this week.

fetchSteps.title: Fetch 1: M1 ACV Cumulative by Week for This Quarter
fetchSteps.objective: Retrieve the cumulative sum of M1 ACV by week for the current quarter, with all mandatory filters applied, to enable week-over-week comparison.
fetchSteps.requiredData: Columns: [Opportunity M1 Date] (aggregated to weekly), cumulative_sum([Opportunity M1 Starting ACV], [Opportunity M1 Date], quarter_number([Opportunity M1 Date])) as [Cumulative M1 ACV]. Filters: [Opportunity M1 Date] is 'this quarter', weekly aggregation applied, [Opportunity Type] IN ('existing customer expansion', 'new customer'), [Opportunity Deployment] != 'mode'.
fetchSteps.fetchPrompt: Calculate the cumulative sum of [Opportunity M1 Starting ACV] by [Opportunity M1 Date], restarting for each quarter using the formula cumulative_sum([Opportunity M1 Starting ACV], [Opportunity M1 Date], quarter_number([Opportunity M1 Date])). Apply filters for weekly aggregation and 'this quarter' on [Opportunity M1 Date]. Also filter where [Opportunity Type] is either 'existing customer expansion' or 'new customer', and [Opportunity Deployment] is not equal to 'mode'. Include columns [Opportunity M1 Date] at weekly granularity and the calculated [Cumulative M1 ACV].

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 1: Identify M1 ACV for Last Week and This Week
analysisSteps.aggregation: No additional aggregation needed; use the fetched [Cumulative M1 ACV] directly for each week.
analysisSteps.question: What was the cumulative M1 ACV at the end of last week and at the end of this week (current week-to-date)?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: You are provided with a table containing [Opportunity M1 Date] at weekly granularity and [Cumulative M1 ACV] for the current quarter. Identify the two most recent weeks in the data. The second most recent complete week represents 'last week' and the most recent week represents 'this week' (current week-to-date). Extract the [Cumulative M1 ACV] value for last week and the [Cumulative M1 ACV] value for this week. Report these two values clearly labeled as 'M1 ACV until Last Week' and 'M1 ACV until This Week'.

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 2: Calculate M1 ACV Change and Percentage Change
analysisSteps.groupBy: No grouping; calculation across the two identified weeks.
analysisSteps.aggregation: Subtraction and percentage calculation: Change = [M1 ACV until This Week] - [M1 ACV until Last Week]; Percentage Change = (Change / [M1 ACV until Last Week]) * 100.
analysisSteps.question: What is the absolute change and percentage change in M1 ACV from last week to this week?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: Using the values identified in the previous analysis step ([M1 ACV until Last Week] and [M1 ACV until This Week]), calculate the absolute change by subtracting the last week value from this week value. Then calculate the percentage change as (Change / [M1 ACV until Last Week]) * 100. Present the results in a summary format showing: 'M1 ACV until Last Week', 'M1 ACV until This Week', 'Absolute Change', and 'Percentage Change'. Provide a brief insight on whether M1 ACV is trending positively or negatively week-over-week.

fetchSteps.title: Fetch 4: No Additional Data Fetch Required
fetchSteps.objective: This phase synthesizes insights from previous analyses; no new data fetch is needed.
fetchSteps.requiredData: Results from Analysis 1.1.2 (M1 ACV change), Analysis 2.1.2 (M1 Count change), and Analysis 3.1.2 (S0 ACV change).
fetchSteps.fetchPrompt: No fetch prompt required. This step uses outputs from previous analysis steps.

analysisSteps.title: Analysis 7: Consolidated KPI Performance Report
analysisSteps.aggregation: No aggregation; summary and comparison of percentage changes across KPIs.
analysisSteps.question: How are all three KPIs (M1 ACV, M1 Count, S0 ACV) trending week-over-week, and which KPI shows the strongest or weakest momentum towards quarterly targets?
analysisSteps.analysisPrompt: You are provided with the week-over-week change analysis for three KPIs: M1 ACV (from Analysis 1.1.2), M1 Count (from Analysis 2.1.2), and S0 ACV (from Analysis 3.1.2). Each analysis includes 'until Last Week', 'until This Week', 'Absolute Change', and 'Percentage Change'. Create a consolidated summary table displaying all three KPIs side-by-side with these four metrics. Identify which KPI has the highest positive percentage change (strongest momentum) and which has the lowest or negative percentage change (weakest momentum or decline). Provide actionable insights: If any KPI is declining or growing slowly, flag it as requiring attention. If KPIs are growing strongly, highlight this as positive momentum towards quarterly targets. Conclude with a brief executive summary of overall KPI health and trending direction for the quarter.
